In this video, we break down the complete chain of events that led to the catastrophe—from an airport explosion that diverted flights, heavy fog that reduced visibility, airport congestion, refuelling delays, and critical communication misunderstandings between pilots and air traffic control. You'll see how a series of small errors, unfortunate decisions, and bad timing combined to create one of the most tragic accidents ever recorded.
